title: What Da Dog Doin?
blurb: A profound philosophical enquiry, posed whenever a dog is doing absolutely anything at all. Universal applicability is the trick: the dog is always doin something, the question always deserves asking, and no answer has ever been required or offered. It works on any animal caught mid-activity. Also on any human behaving inexplicably in the middle distance. There is something genuinely lovely about a meme whose entire content is uncomplicated curiosity. One of the purest and dumbest and most widely beloved sounds on the internet.
origin: From a viral video of someone earnestly asking what the dog is doing.
